Architecture

Cross-zone handoff: one character, one writer

Individual ClientTravel connects a client to another dedicated server. It does not move the whole source population.

On this page
State machineSequence diagram in table formWhy the fencing point is before arrival acknowledgmentTravel mechanismsFailure matrixAcceptance fixture

State machine

Requested -> Frozen -> DestinationReserved -> TicketIssued -> Redeemed -> Arrived -> Completed. Before redemption, failure may cancel and resume source under the still-current epoch. After redemption, source is permanently fenced; recovery must proceed from the backend current epoch to destination or a safe hub, never restore the old writer.

Sequence diagram in table form

StepClientSource zoneBackend / destination
1Interact with GateIdVerify alive, range/LOS, gate destination/requirements, no blocked transactionNo write yet
2Show preparing state, stop repeated inputStop new economics; cancel gather/fish/casts per policy; wait for accepted commands to settleReject preparation if an unresolved trade/commit cannot settle safely
3Loading UI stays localPersist accepted snapshot/revision and freeze session; keep old body noninteractiveRecord TransferId, source epoch, snapshot and freeze state
4Still connected to sourceRequest destination reservationAllocate compatible target with capacity lease; if full cancel before travel
5Receive target route and opaque ticketIssue controlled ClientTravel on this player controller onlySign short-lived account/character/version/destination/nonce ticket; store nonce hash
6Connect target; old widgets clearedNo new mutations while frozenTarget authenticates ticket and identity; transactional one-use redemption compares source epoch
7Wait for admitted bodyAny late source mutation is rejectedRedemption increments/assigns current epoch to destination BEFORE it can write; construct one PlayerState/Character from snapshot
8Observe correct appearance/inventory/quests and arrivalRetire old body/session resources on completion acknowledgmentTarget acknowledges arrival; mark transfer completed; release reservation
9Resume input only when target readyOther source players remain presentReceipt replay never creates another body or repeats rewards

Why the fencing point is before arrival acknowledgment

Waiting until the final UI acknowledgment to revoke source authority leaves a dual-writer interval if the target has already begun play. This design records the new epoch atomically at ticket redemption. The final acknowledgment only finalizes cleanup. This is an explicit refinement of the suggested ordering, preserving its no-duplicate-authority requirement.

Travel mechanisms

Use APlayerController::ClientTravel to the validated server endpoint for the selected player. ServerTravel changes the server world and its connected population; reserve it for whole-zone process transitions where explicitly intended. Local streamed sublevels/World Partition load cells inside the same world and do not perform account admission, persistence or cross-server routing. Initial independent-server handoff uses a non-seamless reconnect with loading UI; do not promise Unreal seamless travel migrates live Actors between independent servers.

Failure matrix

Failure pointRequired outcome
Invalid gate/destinationInvalidDestination; remain source, no freeze or charge
Destination full before ticketRelease reservation, cancel transfer/freeze and resume source under current epoch
Source crashes before redemptionBackend sees frozen source snapshot; reconnect coordinator either cancels/fences safely or issues fresh destination admission; one epoch only
Duplicate ticketOne redemption; later attempts return completed/in-progress status or UsedTicket, never a second body
Destination crashes after redemptionOld source stays fenced. Reconnect from backend to replacement destination/safe hub with another epoch increment
Client disconnects during loadResume same transfer/status or new safe admission; no reward replay
Token expires before redemptionCancel reservation/ticket, verify source epoch unchanged before resuming; otherwise recovery flow
Late source save packetStaleSession; log and discard
Corrupted snapshot/unknown catalogRecoveryRequired/PatchRequired before possession; quarantine, do not create a default wealthy/empty character

Acceptance fixture

Start Zone_A L_Rillmere and Zone_B L_Thornweald with reciprocal north/south GateIds. Connect A and B to Rillmere. A carries one sword GUID, ore quantity, quest count and currency revision. A uses north gate; B remains. Confirm A target epoch increased, same durable IDs, one body, no new reward receipts. Try the old token and old source mutation. Return through the reciprocal gate and repeat under packet loss.
